title: Florida House, District 18
what_it_does: Represents District 18 (Part of St. Johns) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Kim Kendall
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: State representative; former FAA air traffic controller and dry-cleaning business owner
candidates.background: Kim Kendall of St. Augustine was elected in 2024 after two decades of community advocacy on education and infrastructure. A Navy dependent raised on bases abroad, she worked as an FAA air traffic controller and owned two dry cleaners, and she sponsored legislation to block a proposed land swap at the Guana River preserve.

immigration.summary: Kendall voted for SB 2-C in 2025 and in a 2024 survey strongly agreed the U.S. should physically secure the southern border.

guns.summary: She voted in 2025 and 2026 to lower the long-gun purchase age and in a 2024 survey answered 'None' when asked what gun restrictions are needed.

growth.summary: Kendall says she voted against the Live Local Act and the Blue Ribbon bill, but she voted for SB 686, the agricultural-enclave law now drawing criticism in St. Johns County; she says it preserved local approval.
growth.quote: We've done it before — alerting constituents on the Live Local Act and the Blue Ribbon bill (I voted against both).

environment.summary: She sponsored a successful bill to curb land swaps in environmentally sensitive areas after fighting the Guana River WMA proposal.

candidates.name: Art Stresing
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Attorney; division chief at the Public Defender's Office, 4th Judicial Circuit
candidates.background: Art Stresing, 43, is a division chief in the Jacksonville-area Public Defender's Office, where he has worked for more than 11 years. The son of a disabled Navy veteran and a Filipino immigrant, he played Division I football at the University at Buffalo, earned his law degree at Florida Coastal and lives in St. Johns with his wife, an active-duty Navy sailor.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

healthcare.summary: Stresing wants to expand Medicaid so childless adults and struggling families are covered and says Medicaid's low administrative costs show the focus should be on people, not profits.
healthcare.quote: I would like to expand Medicaid so that childless adults and struggling families are covered and not bankrupted by medical expenses.

sources.title: News4JAX 2026 Voter's Guide: Florida House District 18
Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Art Stresing
